wa_goode_mountain_megalodon_ridge.skip_reason: no prose fix; pitch-count proposal goes to classification review

findings.claim: stored pitches 8 undercounts the route; ~20 pitches is the widely given count
findings.evidence: One route database gives 3,000 ft / 20 pitches. A climbing-news account of the first ascent says the route would total more than 20 pitches if pitched out; the party belayed only 7-8 and simul-climbed the rest. The stored 8 matches the belayed-pitch count of one simul-climbing party, not the route's pitch count. Two independent sources agree on ~20.

The first-ascent reports (AAJ, Alpinist) give IV+ 5.10: the direct crest line on the SE Peak headwall is two 5.10 crack pitches. The database gives 5.9 because it rates the three-pitch variation to the left. The stored 5.10 is the route as first climbed, and pitch_detail already describes both lines. No change.

pitches.evidence: Database: 20 pitches / 3,000 ft. First-ascent news account: more than 20 if pitched out, of which 7-8 were belayed. Stored 8 is the belayed count of a simul-climbing party.
